[SWS_CM_10076] Serializing arrays
Upstream requirements:
RS_CM_00201, RS_CM_00202, RS_CM_00211
⌈
A array shall be serialized as the concatenation of the following elements:
• the length indicator which holds the length (in bytes) of the following array
• the array which contains the serialized elements of the array
where the size of the length field shall be determined as specified by
ApSomeip-
TransformationProps
.
sizeOfArrayLengthField
which applies to the array
⌋
